map_subtitle: Calls, events, databases and contracts, read from each service's base branch.
map_diagram_title: Service map diagram. The list of links says the same in words.
map_legend_undeclared: Found in the code, not declared
map_services_hint: Pick a service to see what a change of it reaches.
map_links_empty: No link found between the services yet.
map_state_both: declared and found in the code
map_state_declared: declared, not found in the code
map_state_undeclared: found in the code, not declared in the workspace
map_impact_contract: Its contract ({format}, {path}) changes first, in a contract step.
map_impact_must_one: {names} must change in the same ticket, or the release card blocks unless the change stays backward compatible.
map_impact_must_many: {names} must change in the same ticket, or the release card blocks unless the change stays backward compatible.
map_impact_undeclared: The workspace file does not declare that {from} calls {to}: the release train does not know this call.
map_impact_none: No service calls it, listens to it or shares its databases.
map_problem_fetch_failed: Could not be fetched: the map shows the last base read
map_down: The service map is not available: the service runs no workspace.
map_read_failed: The service map could not be read. Try again in a moment.
map_refresh_failed: The map could not be refreshed. Try again in a moment.
map_connect_hint: No workspace yet? Pick its repositories in the assistant.
test_values_panel_intro: The values each service's tests need, such as a sandbox account, kept encrypted on this machine and given to the tests only.
test_values_unreadable: Cannot be read: it was saved under another key, as when the ledger is copied to a new machine. Set it again.
test_values_gone: No longer in the workspace: its values are given to no session. Remove them.
test_values_warning: Test values only, never production ones: the session's agent can read them. Cleared removes them from the events, comments and pull requests it writes.
test_values_next_session: A change reaches the next session that starts.
test_values_no_workspace: Connect a workspace first: each of its services gets its test values here.
test_values_key_unusable: The key file secrets.key, in the service's state folder, is refused: no value can be saved or given until it is fixed. The service's log says why.
test_values_name_hint: As the tests read it from the environment: capitals, digits and _, for example PAYMENT_SANDBOX_KEY.
test_values_value_hint: One line, 8 characters at least. It is encrypted on this machine and never shown again.
test_values_error_name: A name is written in capitals, digits and _, a capital first, 64 characters at most.
test_values_error_reserved: Cleared or the session's tools set this name (the proxy, the home folder, the model's login, Node, git). Pick another.
test_values_error_short: A value has 8 characters at least, so that Cleared can find it and remove it from what it writes.
test_values_error_long: A value has 4096 characters at most.
test_values_error_line: A value is one line, with no control character. For a key file, save it encoded in base64.
test_values_error_space: The value starts or ends with a space: check what was pasted.
test_values_error_count: A service holds 50 values at most. Remove one first.
test_values_error_key: The key file cannot be used. The service's log says why.
test_values_error_service: This service is not in the workspace.
test_values_error_invalid_workspace: The workspace file cannot be read. The checks step says why.
test_values_error_body: The form did not arrive whole. Try again.
test_values_error_empty: Save a value first, or skip this step.
test_values_error_other: The change could not be made. Try again in a moment.
profiles_intro: Each session starts on the current version of both and keeps it to its end. A change makes a new version; Restore makes an old one the next version. Changes are sent to the service's API, and no secret goes in either: the connections stay with the service.
profiles_restore_agent_label: Restore version {version} of the agent profile
profiles_restored: Version {version} is now the current one, a copy of version {from}.
profiles_network_model_only: the model API and the npm registry only
profiles_error_body: The change names a field this object does not have.
profiles_error_harness: The harness is Claude Code or automatic. Codex and Cursor are reached through the automatic pick.
profiles_error_model: A model is a Claude model id, such as claude-opus-5-5.
profiles_error_same_models: The reviewer must be another model than the author.
profiles_error_prompt: A role prompt is a text of at most 4,000 characters.
profiles_error_tools: Each allowed command names its command first.
profiles_error_mcp: Sessions have no MCP server beyond Cleared's own yet.
profiles_error_skills: Sessions have the project's skills, mounted as they are.
profiles_error_sensitive: This looks like a secret. A profile holds none: the service keeps the connections.
profiles_error_image: The image is one Cleared builds, named cleared-v2-<name>:<tag>.
profiles_error_network: The network is the project's hosts, or the model API alone.
profiles_error_hosts: An allowed host is a host name, and a model-only network adds none.
profiles_error_cpus: The CPUs are a number from 0.5 to 16.
profiles_error_unchanged: That is the current version already.
profiles_error_other: The change could not be made. Try again in a moment.
profiles_first: How the service ran before profiles.
